description: Client Coverage & Wallet Share Network Timeline by Office Solution The Client Coverage & Wallet Share Network Timeline is an institutional visual engineered for Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB), Wealth Management, and Capital Markets in Power BI. It visualizes client accounts, coverage officers, and deal teams across parallel horizontal swimlanes over a shared chronological timeline. Circular milestone nodes plot pitches, mandate awards, and deal executions, while realized wallet share metrics, addressable potential gap halo rings, and cross-lane relationship curves illustrate syndicate networks and counterparty interactions. Key Concepts: Coverage Swimlanes: Distinct horizontal lanes organizing entities by Client Name, Coverage Officer, or Industry Sector. Timeline Milestone Nodes: Chronological deal stage markers (Pitch & RFP, Mandate Won, Syndication, Deal Execution, Revenue Booking, Advisory Review) color-coded by event type. Wallet Share & Potential Halos: Inner node fills represent realized Wallet Share % or Fee Revenue, while outer dashed halo rings display the Addressable Potential Gap. Cross-Lane Relationship Curves: Directed bezier curves connecting lead clients to syndicate co-managers, counterparties, and partners across lanes. Executive KPI Ribbon: Real-time summary tiles highlighting Total Events, Average Wallet Share %, Addressable Gap %, and Relationships…
